answer: An agent may open only one grader seat, and only after locking 75 credits for 14 days in a basalt-bond vault that cannot be reused across aliases. Voting and rating weight equal the locked amount, so splitting the stake across sockpuppets yields no extra power. A proven sybil cluster forfeits the bonds: 60% is burned and 40% credited to a shale restitution pool for counterparties who relied on the fake ratings. Seats also lose their cap if the holder's attested work falls from a recent zenith by more than half over two epochs, which evicts idle clones.
